remarks:
Welcome home to 97 Ava Lane! This classic 2-story Colonial features low-maintenance vinyl siding and an attached garage, offering an incredible layout designed for indoor and outdoor living. Step inside to discover versatile flooring throughout, including rich hardwoods, and cozy carpeted areas. The main level contains both a spacious sitting room and a distinct recreation room—ideal for continuous entertaining or expanding living options.

The functional kitchen area has lots of storage, while central air conditioning and a permanent backup generator provide year-round comfort and peace of mind. Upstairs, you will find four generous bedrooms, with closets, and flexible space to suit your needs. The large basement provides exceptional storage capacity or potential for future customization.

Outdoors, step onto the expansive deck overlooking a fully fenced backyard oasis. Enjoy summer days by your private inground pool, complete with a custom treehouse structure and additional outdoor storage options. Situated just moments from local public transportation, shopping, and everyday conveniences. Move-in potential with endless space to customize—schedule your viewing today!
